q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
Let me work through this systematically.

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is August 16, 2026. NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings announcement is scheduled for August 26, 2026. That's **10 days until the earnings release**, where forward guidance will be announced. This is an extremely short timeframe—guidance is typically set days before the call and rarely changes materially in the final week.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA's current forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 is **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, which translates to a range of $89.18B to $92.82B. This guidance was provided in May 2026 at their Q1 FY2027 earnings call.

The most likely outcome is that the actual Q2 FY2027 forward guidance will fall **within or very close to the current guidance range**. Here's why:

- Companies rarely make dramatic revisions to guidance provided just 3 months prior, unless there's a material business disruption
- NVIDIA has a history of maintaining relatively stable guidance between announcement and actual results
- With only 10 days remaining, any guidance revision would need to be based on concrete business data from the past ~2 months
- The current guidance of $91B already reflects management's best assessment as of May 2026

The question asks what the forward guidance **will be** in the Q2 FY2027 earnings release—this is asking for NVIDIA's updated forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 (typically provided during the Q2 call).

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Demand weakness**: If enterprise capex cycles have slowed or AI infrastructure deployment has decelerated faster than anticipated
- **China export concerns**: Further deterioration in China business (already excluded from guidance, but broader geopolitical risks could impact non-China segments)
- **Competitive pressure**: Unexpected market share losses to AMD or other competitors, though this seems unlikely given current positioning
- **Macro headwinds**: Significant pullback in cloud/enterprise spending

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **Stronger demand acceleration**: If Q2 actual results significantly exceeded the $91B guidance, management might raise Q3 guidance
- **Inventory normalization**: If channel inventory has cleared faster than expected, allowing for accelerated demand
- **AI capex momentum continuation**: If major hyperscalers are accelerating capex beyond previous expectations
- **Margin/mix improvements**: Better product mix or pricing power could drive higher guidance

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: **$81.6 billion** (reported May 20, 2026)
- Q1 FY2027 was reported as "up 20% from the previous quarter" → implies Q4 FY2026 was ~$68B
- Q1 FY2027 was "85% year-over-year" growth
- Current Q2 FY2027 guidance: **$91.0B ± 2%** (range: $89.18B–$92.82B)

This represents:
- ~11.5% sequential growth from Q1 ($81.6B → $91B)
- Continued deceleration from the 20% sequential growth seen in Q1

Historical pattern: NVIDIA's guidance has been relatively achievable with modest upside. The company tends to provide conservative-to-realistic guidance and beat it modestly.

## Analysis

The forward guidance announced on August 26 will be for **Q3 FY2027** (the quarter after Q2). Given:

1. **Current trajectory**: $81.6B in Q1 → $91B guidance for Q2 suggests ~11.5% QoQ growth
2. **Growth deceleration pattern**: Growth is moderating from the 20% QoQ in Q1
3. **Typical guidance pattern**: Companies often show continued growth but at decelerating rates
4. **10-day window**: Very little chance of material revision from current plans

A reasonable expectation for Q3 FY2027 guidance (to be announced in late August) would be:
- Continued growth but slower acceleration than Q2
- If Q2 hits ~$91B, Q3 guidance might be in the ~$95-102B range (5-12% QoQ growth)
- This would maintain the deceleration trend but keep growth positive

Given the range provided (99.5B to 115.5B) and that this appears to be asking for guidance at the Q2 earnings call:

- **Lower bound scenario** (~99.5B): Conservative guidance if management sees slowing
- **Most likely** (~103-105B): Modest acceleration continuation, 5-8% QoQ from Q2
- **Upper bound** (~115.5B+): Only if demand significantly exceeds expectations

The median of provided range is 107.5B. However, this seems slightly optimistic. More realistic would be ~102-104B based on continuation of deceleration trend.

**Final estimate: The forward guidance will likely be in the $100-107B range, with central expectation around $103B.**

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is scheduled to announce its Q2 FY2027 financial results on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, with written commentary available at approximately 1:20 p.m. PT, followed by a conference call at 2 p.m. PT (5 p.m. ET) [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-second-quarter-financial-results-6927195).

For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's current forward guidance predicts revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html), [barchart.com](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3449043/what-to-expect-from-nvidia-s-q2-2027-earnings-report). This outlook does not include any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

The company's Q1 FY2027 revenue, reported on May 20, 2026, was $81.6 billion, up 20% from the previous quarter and 85% year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This was above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).
